name: The Heart of Hakkar

choiceRewards.name: Zandalarian Hero Badge
tooltip: Use: Increases your armor by 2000 and defense skill by 30 for 20 sec. Every time you take melee or ranged damage, this bonus is reduced by 200 armor and 3 defense. (2 Min Cooldown)

choiceRewards.name: Zandalarian Hero Charm
tooltip: Use: Increases your spell damage by up to 204 and your healing by up to 408 for 20 sec. Every time you cast a spell, the bonus is reduced by 17 spell damage and 34 healing. (2 Min Cooldown)

choiceRewards.name: Zandalarian Hero Medallion
tooltip: Use: Increases your melee and ranged damage by 40 for 20 sec. Every time you hit a target, this bonus is reduced by 2. (2 Min Cooldown)

statusNote: Changed in Forever. Gives 9,950 experience instead of 10,000, 1 times as much. From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details: The Heart of Hakkar burns from within.  Although the Soulflayer is defeated, the kernel of his power yet remains in this cursed organ.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Heart of Hakkar to Molthor on Yojamba Isle.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, the Heart of Hakkar.  So the Soulflayer has been slain!  Our world is saved!adventurer, your service to us cannot be overstated.  You truly are a hero of this realm!
narrative.requestItemsText: adventurer, the reek of an evil soul surrounds you.  Have you been cursed by the Soulflayer?
